basics.name: Victor Gaudiot
basics.label: Mobile Software Engineer | iOS
basics.summary: Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience in different industries such as mobility, cyber security, and igaming. Main technologies include Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, XCTest, Flutter, and AI tools . Currently serving as an iOS Software Engineer at Uber, working on the Identity Verification team, a highly critical workflow responsible for verifying +40M users daily, identifying and preventing fraudsters, ensuring a frictionless verification flow, defining new verification methods and frameworks, with a strong focus on AI-driven solutions, and mentoring entry-level engineers. Regarding soft skills, usually described by co-workers as a very proactive team player, with great communication skills, besides a fast learner with a high level of attention to details, always focused on high-impact results. Notable achievements include reducing Server-Driven UI development time by ~60% (from ~5 to ~2 working days) by creating an AI agent skill that uses Figma MCP to turn designs into code, leveraging a harness to enforce codebase standards and generate automated tests, thus accelerating feature delivery while maintaining code quality.

work.name: Uber
work.description: Global technology company operating one of the world's leading mobility, delivery, and logistics platforms.
work.summary: Currently serving as an iOS Software Engineer at Uber, working on the Identity Verification team, a highly critical workflow responsible for verifying +40M users daily, identifying and preventing fraudsters, ensuring a frictionless verification flow, defining new verification methods and frameworks, with a strong focus on AI-driven solutions, and mentoring entry-level engineers.
highlights: Reduced by ~60% (from ~5 to ~2 days) the Server-Driven UI development time by developing an AI agent skill integrated with Figma MCP and a testing harness to autonomously implement designs in Golang while following codebase standards.

Reduced by ~40% (from ~5 to ~3 days) the verification flow development time by designing a modular, backend-driven verification framework using Swift, SwiftUI, and Golang , enabling faster development and easier maintenance of verification flows.

Increased by ~6% (from ~153k to ~162k users) the user verification completion by redesigning the verification journey to reduce user friction, using Golang, Swift, and SwiftUI , with Grafana monitoring during a controlled rollout.

work.name: Rei do Pitaco
work.description: One of Brazil's leading homegrown iGaming and sports entertainment companies, originally built as the country's largest daily fantasy sports platform.
highlights: Prevented +$6M in potential losses by taking technical ownership of a critical regulatory project, coordinating engineers, breaking down milestones into tasks, and working with Product and Legal teams to prioritize requirements using Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Flutter .

Increased by ~20% (from ~123k to ~148k users) the paying user base by proactively identifying and redesigning the product discovery experience, making it easier for users to find relevant content using Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Flutter .

Reduced by ~43% (from ~7 to ~4 days) the feature delivery time by implementing a Server-Driven UI framework in Flutter , allowing engineers to launch, modify, or remove UI features remotely with fast rollbacks and no app store resubmissions.

work.name: Elife Monitor
work.description: Global customer experience and market intelligence company specializing in Social CRM, conversational solutions, and digital customer engagement.
highlights: Increased by ~5% (from 4.5 to 4.7 out of 5) the NPS score by implementing a new chatbot version which uses LangChain and AI tools to fetch user and company information to provide a more custom service , using Node.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, and AI tools .

Fixed a critical bug that caused users to receive duplicate WhatsApp bulk messages by implementing idempotency keys to prevent duplicate message registrations and deliveries, using Node.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, and MongoDB .
